name: Auspicious Kirin
description: Kirin, a traditional Chinese auspicious animal, is collectively known as the "Four Spirits" together with the phoenix, turtle, and dragon. It is said that it can live for two thousand years and is a symbol of auspiciousness, peace, and longevity. It combines a lion's head, antlers, tiger's eyes, an elk's body, a dragon's scales, and an ox's tail. It can spit out flames from its mouth, roar like thunder, and is majestic and ferocious. Qilin has profound connotations in traditional Chinese culture. There are popular sayings that "Qilin sends children" and "Qilin steps on auspicious clouds, causing all kinds of disasters in the world". Therefore, Qilin is often made into ornaments and ornaments for wearing or placing at home to pray for health.
